description.zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认值为1。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分组名称。

- 传入分组名称，则根据名称进行查询。不支持分组名称模糊查询。
- 若不传入此参数，则进行全量分组查询。
description.en:
The name of the group.

*   If you specify this parameter, the system queries groups by group name. You can perform a fuzzy search by group name.
*   If you do not specify this parameter, the system queries all groups.

description.zh:
待查询的分组类型。

目前仅支持传入一个，且为**LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC**，表示动态分组。不传入时，默认为静态分组。
description.en:
The type of groups to query.

Currently, only one value is supported: **LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC**, which indicates a dynamic group. If this parameter is not specified, static groups are queried by default.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 每页记录数。最大值是200。默认值是10。
description.en: The number of the entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 200. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 父组ID。查询某父组下的子分组列表时，需传入此参数。
description.en: The ID of the parent group. If you need to query the subgroups of a parent group, specify this parameter.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。

 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 100.

 > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-device-group-list --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --page-size 10 --super-group-id 8vDubXr4nUvZkNgk9mle010200 --group-name GroupName1 --current-page 1 --group-types example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
